Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 3

“Do not yield to this unmanly weakness, Partha — it does not suit you. Shake off this petty faintness of heart and rise, scorcher of foes.”

The tone is deliberately bracing, almost a slap. Krishna appeals to Arjuna's own self-image as parantapa, scorcher of foes, using the name itself to remind him who he has been.
